failure_modes: If a temporal_teacher blend were applied, the observed-node contrast sign changes and strong sign conflicts could flip the regional attention direction between adjacent score times, displacing surrounding coordinates without any affinity-label evidence of benefit.

If pointcloud_delta_A were narrowed or widened without a supplied spatial-scale basis, the endpoint pointcloud reward could over- or under-penalize the detached Hungarian endpoint distance, changing dose rather than a validated coordinate target.

If teacher_neighbors were changed, the nearest-k teacher mixture would shift mode coverage while teacher provenance and fixed temperatures stay unchanged, and thin ancestral coverage limits within-path inference.
result.rationale: Affinity-first objective (Eaa4bda02c9a2c3a1) with no observed affinity labels (E0857891f4effbfe1, E2bb8390452ed517a) means no registered edit can be shown to improve final predicted affinity; selection enrichment is a geometric descriptor, not an affinity target (H002). H001's time-conditioned contrast is supported only by landmark_00 rows with no accepted polynomial, no extrapolation, multiple sign changes and strong sign conflicts (E2e106e083189d150, Eace79c1f0f54c9d1, E03ad082bb04f4f9c, E894225fb605458cb), and whole-window z magnitudes are small, so a temporal_teacher blend (C009-C011) or temporal_region_index (C008) is not defensibly better than the incumbent static recipe. Distance-curvature choices C001-C003 and neighbor counts C005-C007 lack a supplied spatial-scale/uncertainty basis, and lineage support is thin (Ed0d7945bdeeda8f1), so no offered edit has a defensible expected advantage. Retaining the incumbent preserves the fixed temperatures, shared learned support and native inference.
